verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Computer can 'process … images' and accepts file uploads up to 200 MB, so users can supply photos or screenshots. Nothing documents that it visually interprets or understands image content, as opposed to manipulating files in its sandbox. Its own webpage-screenshot feature is a different capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of vision-based image understanding (OCR, scene or screenshot interpretation), evidence of interpretation accuracy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
